summary: Show the birds heard by BirdNET-Go on your Mac or Linux computer.
page_description: A quiet offline viewer for bird collages detected and rendered on your own computer.
release_notes: Open the latest host-pushed bird collage, see when it was updated, and keep the last complete snapshot offline.

steps.text: Run BirdNET-Go and Fugleramme on a Mac or Linux computer with a microphone.
Start the companion through the existing owner-attended SSH path.

user: Somebody who wants the garden's latest birds on an existing Kobo.
job: Keep the last complete bird collage readable away from the listening computer.
offline: The last pushed collage, update time and recent list remain readable without Wi-Fi.

data.kind: bird snapshot and collage pushed from your computer
data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the source stays on your computer

non_goals: It does not record audio or run BirdNET on the Kobo.
It does not move audio clips to the reader.
